verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question for a hosted API with SDKs, a CLI and an MCP server. Examples would be data-retention or training opt-outs, or switching off SDK/CLI telemetry. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any such control. The only usage-related items cover rate-limit tiers and per-request token counts, which concern billing, not tracking opt-out.
